program:
alphabet a b

is_bos = bos
is_a = symbol a
is_b = symbol b
h1_1 = rightmost(!is_a@i & is_b@i, !is_a@i & is_b@i & !is_b@j)
h2_1 = rightmost(!is_bos@j, !h1_1@i & !is_bos@j & !is_a@j & is_b@j)
h2_2 = leftmost(is_a@i & !is_b@i & !h1_1@i & !is_bos@j, is_a@i & !is_b@i & !h1_1@i & !is_bos@j)
h3_1 = rightmost(!h2_2@i, !h2_2@i & !is_b@j)
h4_2 = leftmost(!h1_1@i & !h3_1@i & !is_bos@j, !h1_1@i & !is_bos@j)
accept = !is_bos & !h2_1 & !h2_2 & !h4_2

output accept
